title: Minnesota vs San Francisco: Player Receiving Yards

This market resolves to Yes if Justin Jefferson records 40 or more Receiving Yards in the game between Minnesota and San Francisco scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 8:20 PM ET, including overtime. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the number of Receiving Yards recorded by the specified player for the specified game. Source Agencies, in order, are NFL.com, ESPN, and FOX Sports.

If the player is listed as active but does not enter the game, the Contract will resolve to the last fair price determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange.
